Definition
[Semi-concavity and quasi-geodesics] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0431, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0432 ↗ lem:chow-iii-g53-distance-derivative 1. appG:G.54,appG:G.56\group Semi-concavity

A locally Lipschitz $f$ is $\lambda $-concave when $f\circ \gamma (s)-\lambda s^2/2$ is concave on every unit-speed geodesic; it is semi-concave when this holds locally with some $\lambda $. A path is a quasi-geodesic if it preserves $\lambda $-concavity for every such function.
